title: Finding the Third Side of a Triangle Using the Law of Cosines (C = 40 Degrees)
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: A triangle has sides of length a = 2 and b = 3 with an included angle of C = 40^\circ. Find the length of side c.

steps.title: Apply the Law of Cosines
steps.explanation: Write the Law of Cosines for side c opposite angle C.
steps.why: The Law of Cosines generalizes the Pythagorean theorem to triangles with any angle C.

steps.title: Substitute the Given SAS Values
steps.explanation: Substitute a = 2, b = 3, and C = 40^circ = 2*pi/9 radians into the formula.

steps.title: Compute the Exact Radical and Decimal Approximation
steps.explanation: Take the positive square root and evaluate numerically to obtain c approx 1.95.
steps.why: Since c > 0, c is the principal square root of 13 - 12*cos(40^circ).
